name: Viserys
one_liner: Gives a coding agent one fixed process from define to ship, as skills.

text.why: An agent improvises its process on every task, and the results swing with it. Viserys packages 28 skills mapped to DEFINE, PLAN, BUILD, VERIFY, REVIEW and SHIP, four reviewer personas and validation scripts as plain Markdown that drops into Claude Code, OpenCode, Cursor and similar tools. An OpenCode agent definition is included: open the folder, press Tab, pick viserys. No license is stated in the README, so check that before adopting it.
text.take: Twenty-eight Markdown files that impose a process instead of improvisation — discipline, not a new tool.
build: A shared skill set so every agent on the team works the same stages
A review step with code-reviewer and security-auditor personas
An in-house skill template written in the same format

who.situation: output quality swings from task to task
wants one written process for agent work

start.text: Clone the repo and point the agent at skills/, or copy it into its skills location
OpenCode: open the repo folder, press Tab and select viserys

caveat: No license stated in the README
Rules in Markdown, not code: the effect depends on how well the agent follows them

numbers.star_delta_unit: GitHub stars gained in the window, GH Archive events summed to as_of
numbers.method: Star total = the value last checked on GitHub (stars_checked_at) + increases observed via GH Archive since. The 24h · 7d · 30d gains are GH Archive hourly events summed to the reference time (as_of). No score of ours.
